FN-2N9XSI-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 482
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Arnold Mooney
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/23/2023
House Bill 482 as introduced could prohibit the use of certain state software systems that would
conflict with the definition of "centralized motor vehicle registration", as provided by this bill.
This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
